verdict.rationale: Figma's Dev Mode (evidenced via figma-docs-23 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection', figma-docs-30 'Translate designs into code', figma-gh-1/figma-docs-25 Code Connect true-to-production snippets) is documented as inspecting layers and generating code snippets, and community evidence (figma-comm-4) confirms a separate Dev Mode license distinct from a full editor seat. However, community hands-on comments describe real friction — CSS-only/absolute-positioning snippets and tedious manual SVG asset export (figma-comm-1, figma-comm-2) — rather than the seamless multi-platform (iOS/Android) snippet and asset pipeline implied by the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of iOS/Android code snippet generation, and independent confirmation that asset export/measurement workflows work smoothly without extra plugins.
